نتناوم (form VI)
# نَتَنَاوَمُ (natanāwamu) /na.ta.naː.wa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
# نَتَنَاوَمَ (natanāwama) /na.ta.naː.wa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
# نَتَنَاوَمْ (natanāwam) /na.ta.naː.wam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
